title: Glenn Gaffney, head of the crash retrieval program, refused to talk
place_text: CIA Directorate of Science and Technology

tellings.quote: Well, I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us.

plain: Between about 2008 and 2012, a man named Glenn Gaffney, at the CIA's science and technology branch, ran what is called the crash retrieval program, a secret effort said to recover crashed craft of non-human origin. That is the account of Eric W. Davis, a physicist who worked on Pentagon UFO studies, who tells Michels he wanted to interview the head of the program from that era, "but he refused to talk to us." If true, it would mean the CIA had a named official in charge of recovering crashed craft.
